components.name: vm-compute (2 x e2-standard-2, 2 x e2-small)
components.residualAfterStop: none after instance deletion; boot disks auto-delete with the instance

components.name: vm-count and size (vCPU quota override, 8 per project)
network egress (level ceiling 1,500 requests x 1 MiB)
components.residualAfterStop: none once traffic stops; the ceiling is a property of the generator, not a provider limit

components.name: persistent disks
components.residualAfterStop: orphaned disks if an instance is deleted but disk auto-delete failed; not covered by the reaper

components.name: VPC flow logs and Cloud Logging
components.residualAfterStop: log storage continues at provider default retention

components.name: evidence bucket (versioning, 7 day soft delete, 30 day retention)
components.residualAfterStop: storage is billed for the whole retention period; a locked retention would make it impossible to delete earlier

components.name: kill-switch function, Pub/Sub, Scheduler
components.residualAfterStop: runs every 5 minutes for as long as the campaign stack exists

components.name: provider budget alerts
components.residualAfterStop: alerts lag billing data by hours and do not stop spend
